other_conditions: Eligible Local statutory bodies, Apex Cooperative Societies, and National level Apex Societies registered under the Society Act/Trust Act or Trust Act

Producer Companies supported by the Office of the DC Handicrafts are eligible provided they have a minimum audited annual turnover of Rs. 1.5 crore in each of the last three consecutive years (excluding Central/State government agencies)
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to INR 800 lakh per urban haat unit (with cost‑sharing between the DC, state implementing agency and others) to develop permanent marketing infrastructure for handicraft artisans, thereby enhancing production, productivity and income.
documents_required: Self‑attested supporting documents in hard copy
